messages:
olivia: quick heads-up 1  onboarding smoke for ember-v1 int6 shows a locale-sensitive regression on mixed CJK+RTL suite (kana ruby + Arabic fragments). BLEU down ~ -8 vs fp16.

sam: ouch. paste eval summary + a failing example?

olivia: eval-bot summary (suite mixed-cjk-rtl-2026-03):
eval-bot: MODEL=ember-v1-int6 | TASK=mixed-cjk-rtl-translate | QUANT=int6 | BLEU=23.0 (int6) vs 31.0 (fp16) | avg_tokens/sent int6=17.0 fp16=12.2 | fail_rate=0.11
example_input: "嵐(あら) said: سلام"
fp16_output: "嵐(あら) said: سلام"
int6_output: "嵐 said: سلام"  (ruby reading dropped; parentheses shifted)

jing: token count difference?
hiro: quick probe:
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
T = Tokenizer('ember')
s = '嵐(あら) said: سلام'
print('fp16', len(T.encode(s, mode='fp16')))
print('int6', len(T.encode(s, mode='int6')))
-> fp16: 12 tokens
-> int6: 18 tokens

sam: q4/q8 behave?
olivia: q4 and fp16 are close to baseline. int6-only regression.

jing: likely candidates: 1) int6 runtime preproc uses a different normalization table (ZWJ/ZWSP handling), 2) fallback tokenization triggered for kana/ruby codepoints, 3) detok glue variant in int6 detok path causing bracket reorder.

hiro: can someone dump token ids for the sample from both runs and attach a diff? that'll tell us split boundaries.
olivia: uploaded token-id diffs and a short repro to internal gist, linked in ticket. gist summary: int6 splits ruby kana into single-char tokens and fragments the Arabic word. detok loses the ruby substring during join.

sam: i'll start a bisect across int6 kernel commits (range f1a..f9c) and run tokenizer-only unit tests to find the first commit that changes token counts.
jing: i'll add a deterministic detok roundtrip smoke for mixed-cjk-rtl to the onboarding CI so we catch orientation/bracket regressions earlier.

hiro: i'll audit the normalization tables packaged with the int6 runtime; maybe an upstream unicode normalization update landed in the int6 build.

olivia: action items: 1) sam - bisect int6 kernels & post earliest bad commit + repro script; 2) jing - add detok+tokenizer smoke to onboarding CI; 3) hiro - compare normalization/preproc across quant paths. Marking P0 and putting ember int6 rollout on hold.

eval-bot: created ticket ML-1508 with failing examples and CI artifacts: https://redwood.internal/ml/ML-1508

sam: bisect started, will update with suspect commit or minimal repro in ~2h.
olivia: thanks all :thumbsup:
